explanation: EXCLURAD radiative correction calculation for eta electroproduction (ep → e'pη) at CLAS12 kinematics. Full O(α) QED radiative corrections with vcut=0.166 GeV² inelasticity cut. delta = σ_obs/σ_Born (radiative correction factor), sigma_Born from EtaMAID-2023 hadronic model. Values reported exactly as written by the code to full precision.
